evals.prompt: I want a new look for the settings screen of this SwiftUI app. Show me some options.
evals.expected_output: the explore stage, in the project's stack or on a design canvas, ending with the choice recorded
assertions: reads DESIGN.md or drafts one before proposing anything
offers at least two alternatives that differ in structure or hierarchy
uses a design canvas if the session has one, otherwise SwiftUI previews
does not introduce a web view or a second UI framework
writes the chosen direction and the rejected one into DESIGN.md

evals.prompt: The sidebar labels get cut off in this React app. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: a focused fix in the existing styling system, checked at several widths
assertions: changes only the truncation behavior
uses the project's existing tokens and styling system
renders the sidebar and checks it at a narrow and a wide width
reports which sizes and states were checked
calls anything it did not render untested

evals.prompt: We're starting a small internal admin tool for five people. What should the front end be?
evals.expected_output: a choice by use case from the choosing reference, with the reason
assertions: asks or states who maintains it and what they already know
recommends the fastest stack the team can maintain with a component kit near its defaults
says where the look comes from and that DESIGN.md should record it
does not recommend a stack only because it is popular
checks current documentation before naming a library version

evals.prompt: Review the onboarding flow of this Flutter app before we release.
evals.expected_output: a pass or fail review of the rendered flow with ranked findings
assertions: runs the flow and looks at it, on a phone size and a larger size
checks the largest text scale, dark appearance and reduced motion
reports findings as P0, P1 or P2 with a location and a change for each
reports numbered open items from DESIGN.md without changing them
does not edit code during the review

evals.prompt: Add a retry button to the failed-upload row in this Compose screen.
evals.expected_output: the ship stage for a small change that a person will see
assertions: uses the theme's colors, typography and shapes with no literal values
gives the button a content description and a 48 dp target
keeps one prominent action in the view
checks the row in its loading, error and long-text states
lists the surfaces and states checked
